plan: [My value equals the current price (30). Staying risks the price rising to 30.5+ and a negative payoff. Dropping guarantees zero profit; staying cannot yield positive profit, so I drop.]

Value is $28; current price $28.5 already exceeds my value. Winning now yields −$0.5 and staying risks winning at equal or higher price for a larger loss. Drop to avoid negative payoff and secure zero profit.

My value equals the current price, so winning now yields zero profit; winning after the price rises would produce negative profit. Since I can't observe others and risk paying above my value, I should drop to guarantee a nonnegative payoff.
